Dexamethasone Response in Airway Smooth Muscle Cells (airway, RNA-seq)

  • 1. Data import
  • 2. Cleaning and quality control
  • 3. Exploratory analysis
  • 4. Differential expression (DESeq2)
  • 5. Functional enrichment (optional)
  • 6. Interpretation notes
  • 7. Reproducibility
# ---- ONE-TIME INSTALLS (run in Console, NOT here) ----
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "pheatmap"))
# BiocManager::install(c("DESeq2", "airway"))
# Optional (gene symbols + GO enrichment):
# BiocManager::install(c("org.Hs.eg.db", "clusterProfiler"))

library(airway)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)

set.seed(42)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5, dpi = 150)

# Output folders (relative to code/ folder)
fig_dir <- file.path("..", "figures")
res_dir <- file.path("..", "results")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(res_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

1. Data import

data("airway")                      # RangedSummarizedExperiment object
se <- airway

dim(se)                             # genes x samples
## [1] 63677     8
as.data.frame(colData(se)) %>%
  select(SampleName, cell, dex, Run)  # sample metadata

2. Cleaning and quality control

# Set "untrt" as reference level
se$dex <- relevel(se$dex, ref = "untrt")

# Build DESeq2 object: control for cell line, test treatment
dds <- DESeqDataSet(se, design = ~ cell + dex)

# Remove low-count genes
n_before <- nrow(dds)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 4, ]
cat("Genes before:", n_before, "| after filtering:", nrow(dds), "\n")
## Genes before: 63677 | after filtering: 16139
# Library sizes
lib <- tibble(sample = colnames(dds),
              reads  = colSums(counts(dds)),
              dex    = dds$dex)

p_lib <- ggplot(lib, aes(sample, reads / 1e6, fill = dex)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Library size per sample", x = NULL, y = "Million reads") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_lib

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "01_library_size.png"), p_lib, width = 7, height = 4)

3. Exploratory analysis

# Variance-stabilising transformation for visualisation
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

# PCA
pca <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("dex", "cell"), returnData = TRUE)
## using ntop=500 top features by variance
pct <- round(100 * attr(pca, "percentVar"))

p_pca <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = dex, shape = cell)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  labs(title = "PCA of VST-transformed counts",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", pct[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", pct[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_minimal()
p_pca

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "02_pca.png"), p_pca, width = 7, height = 5)

# Sample-to-sample distance heatmap
dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(t(assay(vsd))))
rownames(dist_mat) <- paste(vsd$dex, vsd$cell, sep = "-")
colnames(dist_mat) <- NULL

ph1 <- pheatmap(dist_mat, main = "Sample distances", silent = TRUE)
png(file.path(fig_dir, "03_sample_distance.png"),
    width = 1000, height = 800, res = 150)
grid::grid.draw(ph1$gtable)
dev.off()
## png 
##   2
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(ph1$gtable)

4. Differential expression (DESeq2)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
## estimating size factors
## estimating dispersions
## gene-wise dispersion estimates
## mean-dispersion relationship
## final dispersion estimates
## fitting model and testing
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("dex", "trt", "untrt"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(res)
## 
## out of 16139 with nonzero total read count
## adjusted p-value < 0.05
## LFC > 0 (up)       : 2190, 14%
## LFC < 0 (down)     : 1891, 12%
## outliers [1]       : 0, 0%
## low counts [2]     : 313, 1.9%
## (mean count < 10)
## [1] see 'cooksCutoff' argument of ?results
## [2] see 'independentFiltering' argument of ?results
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ensembl") %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Optional: add gene symbols if org.Hs.eg.db is installed
if (requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  res_df$symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = res_df$ensembl, keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
} else {
  res_df$symbol <- NA_character_
}
## 
## 'select()' returned 1:many mapping between keys and columns
res_df$label <- ifelse(is.na(res_df$symbol), res_df$ensembl, res_df$symbol)

write_csv(res_df, file.path(res_dir, "DE_results_dex_vs_untrt.csv"))
head(res_df, 10)
res_df <- res_df %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >  1 ~ "Up",
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down",
    TRUE ~ "Not significant"))

p_vol <- ggplot(res_df, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(pvalue), colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Up = "firebrick", Down = "steelblue",
                                 `Not significant` = "grey70")) +
  geom_text(data = head(filter(res_df, status != "Not significant"), 10),
            aes(label = label), size = 3, vjust = -0.5, colour = "black") +
  labs(title = "Volcano plot: dexamethasone vs untreated") +
  theme_minimal()
p_vol

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "04_volcano.png"), p_vol, width = 7, height = 5)

table(res_df$status)
## 
##            Down Not significant              Up 
##             461           15188             490
# Top 30 genes by adjusted p-value
top_ids <- head(res_df$ensembl[!is.na(res_df$padj)], 30)
mat <- assay(vsd)[top_ids, ]
mat <- mat - rowMeans(mat)                       # centre each gene
rownames(mat) <- res_df$label[match(top_ids, res_df$ensembl)]

anno <- data.frame(dex = vsd$dex, cell = vsd$cell,
                   row.names = colnames(vsd))
ph2 <- pheatmap(mat, annotation_col = anno, silent = TRUE,
                main = "Top 30 differentially expressed genes")
png(file.path(fig_dir, "05_top30_heatmap.png"),
    width = 1000, height = 1000, res = 150)
grid::grid.draw(ph2$gtable)
dev.off()
## png 
##   2
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(ph2$gtable)

pheatmap(mat, annotation_col = anno,
         main = "Top 30 differentially expressed genes")

5. Functional enrichment (optional)

if (requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {

  sig <- res_df %>% filter(padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
  universe <- res_df$ensembl[!is.na(res_df$padj)]

  ego <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
    gene = sig$ensembl, universe = universe,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENSEMBL",
    ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

  if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
    print(enrichplot::dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15))
    ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "06_go_dotplot.png"), width = 8, height = 6)
  } else cat("No significant GO terms.\n")
} else {
  cat("GO enrichment skipped: install clusterProfiler + org.Hs.eg.db.\n")
}

6. Interpretation notes

  • PC1/PC2 should separate treated from untreated samples and cell lines.
  • Up-regulated genes (e.g. glucocorticoid-response genes) indicate drug effect.
  • Limitation: only 4 cell lines, 8 samples.
  • Relevance: glucocorticoids are standard asthma therapy.
